final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.translink AS tl, t.tradekind AS tk, COUNT(*) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT tk, SUM(c) AS sc FROM s1 GROUP BY tk), s3 AS (SELECT s1.tl, s1.tk, s1.c, CASE WHEN s2.sc = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.sc END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.tk = s2.tk), s4 AS (SELECT tk, AVG(ratio) AS av FROM s3 GROUP BY tk), s5 AS (SELECT s3.tl, s3.tk, s3.c, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.tk = s4.tk WHERE s3.ratio > s4.av) SELECT tk, AVG(c), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5 GROUP BY tk
